description: This file is a JavaScript module implementing the nanoid ID generation library, providing functions like nanoid, customAlphabet, customRandom, and exporting urlAlphabet and random. It handles cryptographic random number generation and pooling to create unique IDs.

methods.name: fillPool
methods.description: Fills the internal random pool buffer with cryptographic random bytes, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: random
methods.description: Generates a Buffer of cryptographically secure random bytes of specified length.

methods.name: customRandom
methods.description: Creates a custom random ID generator function configured with specific alphabet and size, using provided getRandom function.

methods.name: customAlphabet
methods.description: Creates a custom ID generator function with specified alphabet and size.

methods.name: nanoid
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string of default size 21 using the internal random pool.
